title: DevSecOps Engineer
summary: A DevSecOps engineer builds security checks into the automated build and release pipeline (CI/CD), so code, open-source libraries, containers and cloud setup are scanned before anything reaches production. They usually sit in a DevOps, platform or security team and work with developers to fix what the scans find without slowing releases.
dailyDuties: Add SAST, dependency and container image scans to CI/CD pipelines
Triage scan findings and help developers fix the real ones
Set rules for which findings block a merge or a release
Move secrets out of code into Vault or a cloud secrets manager
Scan Terraform and Kubernetes manifests for misconfigurations
Harden Kubernetes clusters and container base images
Collect pipeline evidence for ISO 27001, SOC 2 or PCI DSS audits
